## Set it up

<Steps>
  <Step title="Install the package">
    ```bash
    sudo pacman -S crownos-example
    ```
  </Step>
  <Step title="Enable the service">
    ```bash
    systemctl --user enable --now crownos-example
    ```
  </Step>
</Steps>
